definition: Study B = Sn and Pb with one BX2 unit. For each family use one BX2 and the named ligand package; HDC-DMSO means HDC plus one DMSO. Preserve component stoichiometry and total charge, report atom mapping, and state any proton-transfer/coordination model. The input defines the candidate families, not the preferred structure or outcome.
energy_definition: Report E_bind = E(complex) - sum(E(isolated components)) in eV, with a consistent level for complexes and fragments. More negative means stronger association.
scope: Finite molecular/cluster calculations; claims must be limited to the modeled species and tested search space.
